message.content: The back pain between my shoulder blades started two days ago, and it didn't spread anywhere. After that my legs got weaker until I couldn't stand, and then I lost control of my bowels and bladder. I don't remember exactly how many hours each step took. No injury, no heavy lifting, no fever, no blood thinners or other medicines, and no ongoing illnesses. I wasn't asked about cancer or drug use, so I don't know about that.
